note: Sanitised reference export. Called by every room tile on the Home view: tap toggles the room's lights, hold opens the room view.

toggle_area_lights.description: Toggle every light in one area as a single unit. Called by the room tiles on the Home view, where tap toggles and hold navigates.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area whose lights should be toggled.

sequence.note: expand() flattens a light GROUP into its members, which is the whole reason this is a script and not target: {area_id}. Several rooms hold a group alongside its own members in the same area - light.gallery IS the two gallery bulbs, light.living_room_lights IS h60b0 and the_moon. A call targeting the area hits the group AND each member, so every bulb is toggled twice, once directly and once through the group, and lands back where it started. area_entities() resolves at call time, so a light added to the area later is picked up here with no edit to this script and none to the dashboard.
A room with no lights yet is a no-op, not an error. Every room tile calls this, including the eight that have no lights at all, so this is the normal path rather than an edge case.
Anything lit means the room switch turns everything off. Toggling each light individually would turn a room with one lamp on into a room with the other two on, which is not what a room switch means.
